pages.text: [#](53341a)A wild Flying Monkey is made by the living mutation described under the Mutating Sprig: a Wolf and Owl beneath the cocoa-ringed web and its prepared Grasspers.[#]()
pages.title: Flying Monkeys

pages.text: [#](53341a)Tempt it with Raw Beef or Raw Porkchop until it accepts you; either meat also heals a hurt companion, and dyes colour its feathers.[#]()

pages.name: The Flying Monkey
pages.text: [#](53341a)A fierce little flyer that follows its owner, fights in their defence, breeds when fed, and settles on the ground or in the trees between journeys.[#]()

[#](53341a)Use a filled **Taglock Kit** on your tamed Flying Monkey. The kit is consumed; the monkey flies to that exact living creature or player, carries them beneath it, and returns to the place where you gave the order. A traveller may sneak to drop free.[#]()
pages.title: Courier Orders

pages.text: [#](53341a)Use a **Bound Waystone** or **Blooded Waystone** instead to travel yourself. The waystone is reusable. Same-world journeys are flown; a trail that crosses worlds uses the stone's magic after a safe landing is found.[#]()
[#](53341a)Sneak-use the monkey with an empty hand to cancel an active order.[#]()
